Zenker (born 1938) is a retired media broadcaster and public appearance counselor who gained brief stardom by sitting in for Walter Cronkite on the "CBS Evening News" in 1967.  Zenker studied at the University of Pennsylvania in Philadelphia, from which he received an undergraduate and a law degree.  In 1967 at the age of 28, he was asked to sit in for anchor Walter Cronkite to deliver the nightly news.
